description: Commission of Elections - Elected Mr. Usman Mohomad Mohomad Safar as a member of the Matara Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Matara Municipal Council) due to a member's failure to attend meetings. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new council member under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7), which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local government elections.
